metadata.title: Chip Stocks Look Like They’re in Another Dot-Com Bubble. But This Time Could Be Different. <!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Chip Stocks Look Like They’re in Another Dot-Com Bubble. But This Time Could Be Different.
On the surface, semiconductor stocks appear to be in the same stage of the cycle they were in during the late 1990s—a scary proposition for anyone concerned about a sector collapse.
